findings.title: Image has no build for the node's platform
findings.cause: image docker.io/arm64v8/busybox:1.37.0@sha256:b3b1fa492bae35fe28c5ff48dddb493b9d8a429b3d8b0a92b2e3f0774968acd7 exists, but has no build for linux/amd64, so the node cannot pull it; Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.detail: Back-off pulling image "docker.io/arm64v8/busybox:1.37.0@sha256:b3b1fa492bae35fe28c5ff48dddb493b9d8a429b3d8b0a92b2e3f0774968acd7": ErrImagePull: rpc error: code = NotFound desc = failed to pull and unpack image "docker.io/arm64v8/busybox@sha256:b3b1fa492bae35fe28c5ff48dddb493b9d8a429b3d8b0a92b2e3f0774968acd7": no match for platform in manifest: not found

Failed to pull image "docker.io/arm64v8/busybox:1.37.0@sha256:b3b1fa492bae35fe28c5ff48dddb493b9d8a429b3d8b0a92b2e3f0774968acd7": rpc error: code = NotFound desc = failed to pull and unpack image "docker.io/arm64v8/busybox@sha256:b3b1fa492bae35fe28c5ff48dddb493b9d8a429b3d8b0a92b2e3f0774968acd7": no match for platform in manifest: not found

findings.fix: Use a multi-architecture image that includes the node's platform, or schedule the pod onto nodes it was built for (a nodeSelector on kubernetes.io/arch).
